page_title: VER 1-0 SAS | Verona v Sassuolo 03/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+7' Samu Castillejo (Sassuolo) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.

90+6' Federico Bonazzoli (Verona) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Fabio Maresca no option but to blow his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Sassuolo.
90+4' Uros Racic (Sassuolo) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
90+3' Dangerous play by Pawel Dawidowicz (Verona). Fabio Maresca blows his whistle for a foul. Sassuolo have a free kick.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Marco Baroni decides to make a substitution. Jackson Tchatchoua will be replaced by Giangiacomo Magnani (Verona).
90' Substitution. Tomas Suslov leaves the pitch and is replaced by Ruben Vinagre (Verona).
89' A yellow card for a tackle by Diego Coppola (Verona). Fabio Maresca doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
87' Samu Castillejo (Sassuolo) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
83' Davide Ballardini has decided to substitute Andrea Pinamonti and he is replaced by Samuele Mulattieri (Sassuolo).
83' Here comes a substitution. Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) is brought on as a substitute for Kristian Thorstvedt.
83' Fabio Maresca shows the yellow card to Suat Serdar (Verona) for a heavy challenge.
82' Federico Bonazzoli (Verona) produces a good strike that sails to the middle of the goal, but his low effort ends up in the goalkeeper's gloves.
81' Fabio Maresca shows a yellow card to Juan David Cabal (Verona) for a tough tackle.

79' 1 - 0 Goal! Federico Bonazzoli produces a great pass that finds Karol Swiderski (Verona) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a shot into the bottom right corner. 1:0.
78' Sassuolo failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
74' Tomas Suslov (Verona) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
73' Samu Castillejo (Sassuolo) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Fabio Maresca didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
72' A corner kick by Sassuolo is thwarted by the well prepared Lorenzo Montipo (Verona).
71' The resulting set piece from Sassuolo is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

71' A snap shot by Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom left corner, but Lorenzo Montipo produces a good save to thwart him. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Sassuolo will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
71' A quickly taken corner by Sassuolo.
68' Today's match ends for Daniel Boloca who will be replaced by Uros Racic (Sassuolo).
68' Marco Baroni prepares a substitution. Darko Lazovic is replaced by Federico Bonazzoli (Verona).
67' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Thomas Henry trots off the pitch and is replaced by Karol Swiderski (Verona).
66' Ondrej Duda (Verona) sets himself up on the edge of the box, but balloons his shot way over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sassuolo.
66' Rough tackle by Matheus Henrique (Sassuolo). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
65' Stefan Mitrovic (Verona) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
62' The corner is swung in but Sassuolo can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
60' Davide Ballardini is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Domenico Berardi suffers an injury and Samu Castillejo (Sassuolo) comes on.
60' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Stefan Mitrovic (Verona) is coming onto the pitch as Tijjani Noslin cannot continue after picking up an injury.
59' The game is interrupted. Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) suffers a horrific injury!
58' Sassuolo have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
56' Fabio Maresca couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Suat Serdar (Verona) and blew his whistle. It's a free kick to Sassuolo, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
55' Darko Lazovic (Verona) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
52' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) perfectly wins the ball from the free kick, but his effort from the edge of the penalty area isn't accurate enough and the ball goes a few inches past the left post!
52' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) takes a direct free kick.
51' Fabio Maresca shows a yellow card to Pawel Dawidowicz (Verona), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
48' Tomas Suslov (Verona) controls a reverse pass deep inside the box and smacks the ball low towards the middle of the goal, but the Andrea Consigli anticipates well and smothers the ball.
47' The foul by Matheus Henrique (Sassuolo) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Fabio Maresca.
47' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Juan David Cabal (Verona) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Josh Doig (Sassuolo).
44' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) commits a foul and Fabio Maresca immediately signals a free kick.
43' Tomas Suslov (Verona) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
42' Juan David Cabal (Verona) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
39' Fabio Maresca blows his whistle and it's Thomas Henry (Verona) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
36' Tomas Suslov (Verona) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
34' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.

34' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play. Sassuolo will have a chance to score from a corner.
33' The resulting corner from Darko Lazovic (Verona) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.

33' Juan David Cabal (Verona) makes a yard for himself as he picks up the rebound after chaos in the box and quickly sends a shot towards the left post. The goalkeeper pulls off a remarkable save to keep the ball from hitting the net. What a save! The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Verona.
32' Tomas Suslov (Verona) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the left-hand post, but Andrea Consigli was alert and the score remains the same.
31' Ondrej Duda (Verona) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
30' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball. The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.

29' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. Sassuolo will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
27' Thomas Henry (Verona) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sassuolo.
25' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) strikes the ball towards the right side of the goal despite being in a difficult position, but his shot is intercepted by one of the defenders.
23' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
23' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat. Sassuolo earn a corner.
21' Verona take a short corner kick.
21' Tijjani Noslin (Verona) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The linesman points to the corner flag, Verona are going to take it.

19' Josh Doig (Sassuolo) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the middle of the net is denied by Lorenzo Montipo. This effort really didn't trouble him.
18' Darko Lazovic (Verona) sends a cross into the box, but Andrea Consigli comes off his line to gather the ball.

16' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area. The ball goes out of play and Sassuolo will have a goal kick.
14' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) latches onto a cross inside the box and aims a shot towards the middle of the goal, but Lorenzo Montipo reacts superbly to deny him.
14' Tomas Suslov (Verona) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
12' Tomas Suslov (Verona) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
10' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
8' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
7' Juan David Cabal (Verona) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
6' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sassuolo.
5' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) takes it short.
5' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The referee blows his whistle, Sassuolo are awarded a corner kick.
3' Thomas Henry (Verona) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
3' Ondrej Duda (Verona) tackles a bit over-zealously and Fabio Maresca blows for a foul.
1' Tijjani Noslin (Verona) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant long-range cross, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Verona will have the kick-off.
Fabio Maresca was nominated as the referee for this game.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
